metadata.purpose: Empirical comparison of 1 single agent vs 2 parallel agents under Switchyard fleet spawn & fleet check

evaluationFocus.arm2: Two parallel agents under Git worktree isolation with in-memory Git ORT speculative collision detection

comparisonAnalysis.title: SWE-bench Lite vs. CodeNib Symbol Graph Tasks for Multi-Agent Concurrency Evaluation

sweBenchLite.corpus: 300 selected issues across 12 Python repositories (Django, SymPy, Pytest, Matplotlib, etc.)
sweBenchLite.granularity: Heavily localized; >70% of issues touch 1 file and <20 lines of code (Agentless, Xia et al. 2024)
sweBenchLite.parallelizationViability: Low. Because fixes are localized to a single function or file, spawning two parallel agents produces redundant work, prompt duplication, or artificial text thrashing without natural subtask decomposition.
sweBenchLite.collisionDetectionSuitability: Poor. Parallel agents either execute identical text edits in the same function (trivial merge conflicts) or diverge completely. Fails to simulate realistic cross-module feature decomposition.
sweBenchLite.runtimeOverhead: High. Requires heavy Docker containers (several GB each) with complex Conda environments and legacy Python toolchains, making local multi-agent worktree execution slow and brittle.

codeNibSymbolGraph.corpus: Multi-file symbol graph tasks derived from CodeNib (sysevol-ai/CodeNib) and Switchyard (MohammedAlkindi/switchyard)
codeNibSymbolGraph.granularity: Multi-file structural tasks spanning typed definition-reference graphs, caller-callee hierarchies, interface-implementation boundaries, and regression suites.
codeNibSymbolGraph.parallelizationViability: High. Tasks decompose into natural orthogonal subtasks (e.g. Agent A updates core domain/interface schema; Agent B updates consumer commands, formatters, or integration tests).
codeNibSymbolGraph.collisionDetectionSuitability: Ideal. Systematically exercises all three critical multi-agent concurrency regimes: (1) Disjoint clean merges, (2) Textual merge collisions on shared entrypoints/barrels, and (3) Cross-file semantic breaking collisions where textual merge succeeds (Exit 0) but compiler/tests fail.
codeNibSymbolGraph.runtimeOverhead: Low. Deterministic local execution via Vitest/Node and Pytest in <2-5 seconds per test run with zero Docker container overhead.

comparisonAnalysis.selectionVerdict: Selected CodeNib & Switchyard symbol-graph tasks over SWE-bench Lite to enable fast, reproducible local execution, clean subtask decomposition, and rigorous evaluation of Git ORT textual collisions vs cross-file semantic breakages.

tasks.problemStatement: Extend MCP status and jsonrpc reporting with filtered worktree statuses. Subtask A modifies MCP schema validation and tool handler in packages/switchyard/src/lib/mcp.ts to accept an optional 'statusFilter' array (e.g. ['active', 'stale']). Subtask B updates packages/switchyard/src/commands/status.ts and tests/mcp.test.ts to apply the filter logic and verify serialization.

agentA.name: mcp_tool_schema_filter
agentA.objective: Add statusFilter parameter schema and tool argument validation

agentB.name: status_filter_handler_and_tests
agentB.objective: Implement filter filtering on worktree list and add unit assertions

tasks.validationCriteria: Disjoint file edits allow in-memory Git ORT speculative merge to succeed with Exit 0; all test assertions in tests/mcp.test.ts pass with zero regressions; parallel agent execution achieves speedup over sequential baseline.

tasks.problemStatement: Add CSV and JSONL telemetry export options to ContextBill CLI. Subtask A implements the CSV/JSONL serialization pipeline in packages/contextbill/src/report.ts and re-exports it in packages/contextbill/src/index.ts. Subtask B updates packages/contextbill/src/cli.ts and packages/contextbill/src/__tests__/cli.test.ts to add the '--export <format>' option and verify CLI invocation output.

agentA.name: csv_jsonl_serializer
agentA.objective: Build formatTelemetryExport supporting csv, jsonl, and json formats

agentB.name: cli_flag_integration
agentB.objective: Parse --export CLI flag and route to telemetry report generator

tasks.validationCriteria: Line-interval diff in packages/contextbill/src/cli.ts triggers speculative collision alert in fleet check when both agents register options simultaneously; fleet check detects conflict correctly (True Positive).

tasks.problemStatement: Refactor checkCollisions in packages/switchyard/src/lib/mergetree.ts to accept a structured CheckOptions configuration object ({ maxHunkDistance: number, detectRenames: boolean }) instead of positional boolean parameters. Subtask A refactors the definition and implementation in mergetree.ts. Subtask B implements parallel work in packages/switchyard/src/commands/check.ts assuming the legacy positional parameter signature.

agentA.name: mergetree_options_refactor
agentA.objective: Refactor checkCollisions signature to use structured CheckOptions interface

agentB.name: check_command_feature_update
agentB.objective: Enhance collision reporting output assuming original positional signature

tasks.validationCriteria: Git ORT and textual diffs report clean merge (Exit 0, false negative in pure textual collision detection); TypeScript build (tsc) or vitest detects TS2554 argument count/type mismatch; validates empirical semantic gap.

tasks.problemStatement: Implement exponential sliding-window decay for token waste thresholds to prevent stale historical turns from inflating immediate session waste flags. Subtask A implements computeDecayedWaste in packages/contextbill/src/waste.ts. Subtask B updates packages/contextbill/src/__tests__/waste-thresholds.test.ts with parameterized test vectors.

agentA.name: waste_decay_algorithm
agentA.objective: Implement sliding-window exponential decay on cumulative waste scores

agentB.name: decay_test_suite
agentB.objective: Add unit tests verifying half-life decay on 10, 50, and 100 turn sessions

tasks.validationCriteria: Disjoint file edits; in-memory Git merge completes with 0 conflicts; all 16+ tests pass; demonstrates clean parallel speedup.

tasks.problemStatement: Add SSE streaming support and chunk buffering to the CortexAI gateway inside Switchyard. Subtask A creates packages/switchyard/src/lib/gateway-stream.ts with SSE chunk decoder and backpressure handling. Subtask B integrates the stream handler into packages/switchyard/src/commands/gateway.ts and adds streaming assertions to tests/gateway.test.ts.

agentA.name: sse_stream_decoder
agentA.objective: Implement decodeSSEStream generator with event chunking

agentB.name: gateway_route_integration
agentB.objective: Hook streaming endpoint in gateway route handler and assert test responses

tasks.validationCriteria: Concurrent edits on gateway route registration in packages/switchyard/src/commands/gateway.ts trigger line-interval collision in fleet check; test suite passes once resolved.

tasks.problemStatement: Harden bounded graph payload binary search in CodeNib against cases where root-incident edges alone exceed the 36 KB payload threshold. Subtask A modifies codenib/mcp/tools/dependency.py to truncate identifier names on root-incident edges when necessary. Subtask B adds unit tests in test/guard/test_dependency_bounding.py to assert that payload size strictly respects <= 36864 bytes.

agentA.name: dependency_bounding_edge_truncation
agentA.objective: Add fallback identifier truncation when root-incident edges exceed 36KB

agentB.name: bounding_test_verification
agentB.objective: Construct dense root graph test fixtures asserting byte limit invariants

tasks.validationCriteria: Zero file overlap between implementation and new test fixture; Git ORT merges cleanly; payload strictly bounded under 36 KB.

tasks.problemStatement: Replace text-based SHA256 definition hash in codenib.guard.notes with AST-canonicalized hashing. Subtask A modifies definition_hash in codenib/guard/notes.py to parse source with ast.parse and strip comments/docstrings before hashing. Subtask B updates callers in codenib/guard/report.py and test cases in test/guard/test_notes.py.

agentA.name: ast_canonical_hashing
agentA.objective: Implement AST canonicalization to eliminate cosmetic formatting false positives

agentB.name: guard_report_and_tests
agentB.objective: Integrate AST hash in verification reports and assert comment-invariant hashing

tasks.validationCriteria: If Agent B updates report assertions assuming the old string SHA256 output format, textual merge succeeds cleanly but pytest fails on assertion mismatch; resolves when canonical hash contract is respected.

tasks.problemStatement: Extend file locking in packages/switchyard/src/lib/lock.ts with explicit lease expiration timeouts and process heartbeat tokens to prevent deadlock from killed agent processes. Subtask A updates acquireLock and releaseLock in lock.ts with leaseDurationMs. Subtask B updates call sites in packages/switchyard/src/commands/spawn.ts and tests/lock.test.ts.

agentA.name: lock_lease_heartbeat
agentA.objective: Add lease expiration and heartbeat timestamp verification to avoid stale locks

agentB.name: spawn_lock_integration_tests
agentB.objective: Pass lease options during fleet spawn and add lease expiry unit tests

tasks.validationCriteria: Disjoint file edits; in-memory Git merge passes cleanly; tests verify lease expiration after simulated process crash.
